name: preacher-curl-dumbbell-zottman
title: Preacher Curl: Dumbbell (Zottman)
primer: This is an advanced exercise where you turn the dumbbells up and out using a Preacher Curl bench for support.
steps: Sit at a Preacher Curl Bench.
Grasp a dumbbell in your hand with your palms facing up.
Extend your arm fully along the bench.
Curl your arm up, then turn your wrist so your palm faces down as the dumbbell reaches your chest.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbell with your palm facing down, turn it back up at the bottom, and switch arms.
